summary.text: Eric Ager is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 114 in Buncombe County who has served since January 1, 2023, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as J. Eric Ager, a former U.S. Navy officer who is now director of business operations at Hickory Nut Gap Farm.

paragraphs.text: Ager served in the U.S. Navy, according to Ballotpedia, as an assistant combat direction center and operations department training officer, a helicopter squadron department head, the Europe desk officer and a U.S. naval attache.
The General Assembly lists his military service as U.S. Navy, 1996 to 2021.
He earned a B.S. in political science and government from the U.S. Naval Academy in 1996 and a master's degree in international relations and affairs from Atilim University in Turkey in 2005.

Ager's career has included work as a professor of national security studies at the George C. Marshall Center, as executive director of the nonprofit Project HNG, and as director of business operations at Hickory Nut Gap Farm.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as Hickory Nut Gap Farm Business Operations Director and Project HNG Executive Director.

Ager serves on the House Agriculture and Environment, Finance, Emergency Management and Disaster Recovery, Oversight and Regulatory Reform committees and on the House Select Committees on Helene Recovery, Oversight and Reform, and Property Tax Reduction and Reform.
